description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot', a framework for creating various types of plots within the PEAR Image_Graph library. It handles dataset management, plotting types, marker setting, drawing on a canvas, and calculating bounds for rendering a graph.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot
classes.description: A class serving as a framework for rendering different types of plots in a graph, supporting multiple datasets, stacking, marker configurations, and legend integration. It extends 'Image_Graph_Plotarea_Element' and manages plotting characteristics, dataset bounds, and rendering details.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plot
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plot with a dataset or array of datasets, plotting type, and title. Validates dataset types and sets the plot type.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the plot, used in the legend.

methods.name: setMarker
methods.description: Sets the marker object used to display data points on the graph.

methods.name: setDataSelector
methods.description: Assigns a data selector to specify which data points are visualized.

methods.name: _getMarkerData
methods.description: Calculates additional marker positioning data based on dataset points and plot type for accurate marker placement.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws markers on the canvas for data points.

methods.name: _minimumX
methods.description: Computes the minimum X value across all datasets.

methods.name: _maximumX
methods.description: Computes the maximum X value across all datasets.

methods.name: _minimumY
methods.description: Computes the minimum Y value across datasets, considering stacking for non-normal types.

methods.name: _maximumY
methods.description: Computes the maximum Y value across datasets, considering stacking and percentages.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Converts a data value to an X pixel position, considering plot orientation.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Converts a data value to a Y pixel position, considering plot orientation.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates of the plot area based on parent container dimensions.

methods.name: dataset
methods.description: Returns the dataset(s) associated with the plot.

methods.name: _getTotals
methods.description: Calculates dataset bounds and sum totals for X and Y axes.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a rectangle representing the plot style in the legend.

methods.name: _legendSample
methods.description: Creates a sample marker for the legend display.
